text:
Built and released as v0.115.0: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.115.0

The tail bets, Live light bids, the live taker and the live bids now run on the GitHub engine, priced from BoltOdds' soft-book average and Novig's live feed. Your phone stands down on any of them while the engine says it is running them, and takes them back if the engine goes quiet. Live tab: new 'Run it on GitHub' switch (on by default) and an engine status line. Real money needs the engine's trading set to LIVE plus your own real switches. The soft-book taker and bids also need the 'allow real orders on the average' switch, so they are paper until you flip it. Not moved: the Feed's live-games list stays on the phone, since it is a screen, not an order path. After you update, restart the engine so it picks up the new code. I'll check its live status next.
